copyability.why: Buy-and-hold / resolution harvesting at large notional. Easy mechanically (buy → wait → redeem) but edge is selection + bankroll + path risk, not a simple rule.
build_steps: Build a directional edge model (not a tape-copy) for the same market universe
Enter via maker when possible to cut fees; allow taker for urgency
Exit primarily via REDEEM (and MERGE if pairing YES/NO) — no mid-market sell loop required
Hard per-market and portfolio max inventory; expect multi-day underwater mark-to-market
Paper the full hold-to-resolution cycle including open-risk volatility
steal_from_them: Maker-led entry style (better for quoting bots)
avoid: Their raw size/drawdown — scale down hard
copyability.kalshi_two_sided_mm_fit: MEDIUM — extract risk + hold rules; re-fit microstructure on Kalshi
